170.315(B)(10) ELECTRONIC HEALTH INFORMATION EXPORT

MedConnectHealth is compliant with 170.315(b)(10) and meets the following requirements:

    •   Single patient electronic health information export.
            o Enable a user to timely create an export file(s) with all a single patient’s electronic health
                information that can be stored at the time of certification by the product, of which the Health IT
                Module is a part.
            o A user must be able to execute this capability at any time the user chooses and without subsequent
                developer assistance to operate.
            o Limit the ability of users who can create such export file(s) in at least one of these two ways:
                      To a specific set of identified users
                      As system administrator function.
            o The export file(s) created must be electronic and in a computable format.
            o The publicly accessible hyperlink of the export’s format must be included with the exported
                file(s).

    •   Patient population electronic health information export.
            o Create an export of all the electronic health information that can be stored at the time of
                 certification by the product, of which the Health IT Module is a part.
            o The export created must be electronic and in a computable format.
            o The publicly accessible hyperlink of the export’s format must be included with the exported
                 file(s).

                 To achieve the complete export of all patients, there are 2 available options. A user can perform a
                 single patient export for each individual patient, however because this can become a very time
                 consuming process due to the number of patients within an organization, MedConnectHealth can
                 perform a complete export of all patients upon request.
